meta.title: London cyclist injury collisions, 2025
meta.source: Transport for London, 2025 GLA collision data extracts and 2025 Injury Risk Annex
meta.method: TfL casualty rows filtered to Casualty Mode of Travel = Pedal Cycle and joined to attendant records by _Collision Id.
meta.scope: TfL recorded personal-injury collisions. Risk rates are separately published TfL casualties per million cycle journey stages; 2020 and 2021 cycle journey-stage exposure is unavailable.
meta.mapNote: TfL casualty coordinates are OSGB36 / British National Grid, transformed to WGS84 using the OS seven-parameter Helmert operation (EPSG:1314; approximately 3.5 m transformation accuracy). Original Easting/Northing are retained.
